name: Hector "Manuel" Ortiz
office: City of Irwindale, Member of the City Council

items.text: Hector "Manuel" Ortiz is the mayor of Irwindale and has held a City Council seat since 2005. His official city profile says he advocates for fiscal accountability, youth and senior programs, public safety, and housing opportunities. In 2013, he opposed replacing the city police force with the Sheriff’s Department, saying the department should be kept and improved. That year, he also named bringing in a recycling facility, filling the Manning Pit, and adding affordable housing as priorities. In 2015, he toured a Gold Line station in preparation for an Irwindale stop. In 2014, the Fair Political Practices Commission fined him $400 for failing to file two campaign finance statements on time.
